mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from Answer Engine Optimization for a cosmetic surgery website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO can vary based on several factors, including the competitiveness of your target keywords, the current authority of your website, and the comprehensiveness of your optimization efforts. Generally, you might start noticing improvements in featured snippet appearances and direct answer placements within 3 to 6 months. Significant, sustained impact on patient inquiries and bookings typically takes 6 to 12 months as search engines fully re-index and trust your optimized content. AEO is an ongoing strategy, not a one-time fix, requiring continuous monitoring and refinement.
